foundations.statement: Affine scheme/ring duality, Zariski gluing and sheaf axioms, smooth Lie bundle and arbitrary base change, finite locally free module/sheaf equivalence, separated closed diagonal. Frame representability and all finite-descent arguments are proved in the chapter.

Polynomial and localization universal properties, units and determinants, prime-ideal criterion for reducedness, first isomorphism theorem. The specific localization injection, finite capture and radical quotient proofs are written in TDR6, TDR8 and TDR12.
